# Munal AI - AI-Powered Meeting Assistant
> Transform your meetings with AI technology

## About Munal
Munal is an AI-powered meeting assistant platform developed by Jiffix Inc. It provides real-time transcription, automatic summaries, action items extraction, and team collaboration tools.

## Core Features
- **AI Transcription**: Real-time speech-to-text with speaker identification
- **Meeting Summaries**: Automatic AI-generated meeting summaries and key points
- **Action Items**: Intelligent extraction of tasks and follow-ups
- **Video Meetings**: HD video conferencing with screen sharing
- **Screen Recording**: Record meetings and presentations
- **Calendar Integration**: Sync with your calendar for scheduled meetings
- **Team Workspaces**: Collaborate with team members in shared workspaces
- **Text-to-Audio**: Convert notes to audio for accessibility
- **Text-to-Video**: AI-powered video generation from text
- **File Management**: Secure cloud storage for meeting files

## Use Cases
- Sales Teams: Record sales calls, track commitments, follow up effectively
- Customer Success: Document customer interactions and feedback
- Product Teams: Capture product discussions and decisions
- Engineering Teams: Record technical discussions and architecture decisions
- HR & Recruiting: Interview transcription and candidate evaluation

## Pricing
- **Free**: $0/month - 5 meetings, 30 min transcription, 1GB storage
- **Pro**: $19/month - 50 meetings, 300 min transcription, 5GB storage
- **Business**: $39/month - 150 meetings, 1000 min transcription, 25GB storage
- **Enterprise**: $79/month - Unlimited meetings and transcription, 100GB storage
